sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "death"."caused_by_ship_id" AS e, "ship"."ship_type" AS g, AVG(("death"."injured" - "death"."killed")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "death" JOIN "ship" ON "ship"."id" = "death"."caused_by_ship_id"  GROUP BY "death"."caused_by_ship_id", "ship"."ship_type"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: people injured - people killed: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same one death/attack incident
average of people injured minus people killed per ship within ship.ship_type
gap to the all average of average of people injured minus people killed (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "death"."caused_by_ship_id" AS e, "battle"."result" AS g, SUM(("death"."injured" - "death"."killed")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "death" JOIN "ship" ON "ship"."id" = "death"."caused_by_ship_id" JOIN "battle" ON "battle"."id" = "ship"."lost_in_battle" GROUP BY "death"."caused_by_ship_id", "battle"."result"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

gap to the g average of total of people injured minus people killed (g level)
